grammar_focus: 时态语态综合复习(Review KS26-34:一般现在 These things always happen / 一般过去 What happened / 现在完成 has not regretted / used to drive / 被动 were arrested)主考 + far/much + 比较级(far more exciting)/ such + a + 名词 + that(such a fright that)辅考·课文①类
scene: 罗伊·特雷顿原先开出租车,不久前改开了公共汽车,并不后悔——他觉得新工作有意思得多。最近他开车沿凯特福德街行驶时,看到两个小偷从一家商店冲出来,奔向一辆等着的汽车,其中一个提着一只装满钞票的提包。罗伊行动迅速,把公共汽车直冲小偷开去;拿钱的小偷吓得扔了提包。小偷企图开车逃跑,罗伊把公交车撞进他们车的后尾。趁被撞坏的车开走时,罗伊停车给警察打了电话——小偷的车损坏严重、极易辨认;没过多久,警察截住了车,两人都被抓住。

grammar_card.title: 时态语态综合复习
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习前几课的时态语态:一般现在时(总是发生)、一般过去时(过去发生)、现在完成时(与现在有联系)、used to(过去的习惯)、被动语态(be + 过去分词)。看信号词选对形式。全用本课句子举例。

rows: He saw two thieves rush out.
Roy used to drive a taxi.

specialRules.rule: far / much + 比较级,表示程度'…得多':far more exciting = 有意思得多。
such + a/an + 名词 + that,'如此…以至于…':such a fright that he dropped the bag。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How did Roy stop the thieves?
options: He drove his bus straight at them and into their car

passage: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi. A short while ago, however, he became a bus driver and he has not regretted it. He is finding his new work far more exciting. When he was driving along Catford Street recently, he saw two thieves rush out of a store and run toward a waiting car. One of them was carrying a bag full of money. Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves. The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag. As the thieves were trying to get away in their car, Roy drove his bus into the back of it. While the battered car was moving away, Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police. The thieves' car was badly damaged and easy to recognize, and shortly afterward, the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.

grammar_points.name: 一般现在时(总是 / 现阶段发生)
一般过去时(过去某刻发生)
现在完成时(与现在有联系:has not regretted)
used to(过去的习惯,现已停止)
被动语态(be + 过去分词:were arrested)
far / much + 比较级(…得多,辅考)
such + a + 名词 + that(辅考)

朝,向;美语常用 toward(不带 s),英式 towards(课文 run toward a car)
出租车;美语口语常说 cab,英式 taxi(课文 used to drive a taxi)
